cotester_chat_messages.message:
A new customer launches the application.
The customer taps on the Sign-Up button.
The system displays the Sign-Up screen.
The customer enters the first name (John).
The customer waits for 2 seconds.
The customer enters the email address (John.doe@gamil.com).
The customer waits for 2 seconds.
The customer enters the password (John@123).
The customer waits for 2 seconds.
The customer taps on the Confirm Password field.
The customer enters the confirm password (John@123).
The customer waits for 2 seconds.
The customer taps on the Sign-Up button.
The system processes the registration request.
The customer is registered successfully.
The system proceeds to the appropriate next screen.
The customer sign-up process is completed successfully.

Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Successful Customer Sign-Up with Valid Details
Module: User Registration / Sign-Up
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- The application is installed and ready to launch on the customer’s device.
- The customer does not have an existing account with the same email address.

Test Steps:
1. Launch the application.
2. Tap on the Sign-Up button on the welcome or login screen.
3. Verify that the Sign-Up screen is displayed.
4. Enter "John" in the first name field.
5. Wait for 2 seconds.
6. Enter "John.doe@gamil.com" in the email address field.
7. Wait for 2 seconds.
8. Enter "John@123" in the password field.
9. Wait for 2 seconds.
10. Tap on the Confirm Password field.
11. Enter "John@123" as the confirm password.
12. Wait for 2 seconds.
13. Tap on the Sign-Up button.
14. Observe the system processing the registration request.

Expected Result:
- The system displays an indication that the registration request is being processed.
- The customer is registered successfully with the provided email and password.
- The system navigates to the appropriate next screen after successful registration (such as a welcome screen or dashboard).
- The sign-up process is completed and the customer is able to proceed further in the application.
